d:
Here's A Doemain of Our Own. A furry webcomic comic created Susan Rankin (also known as SusanDeer).
The story concerns the life of a doe writer named Sue Hartland and the strange adventures she finds herself in, as well as her hectic social life.

The comic started on April 24th, 1999 and ended in November 14th, 2008.

Pages 1-582:
Is the newer higher rez version of the comic.
The comic was reupdated with the newer cleared up pages around December of 2019 after the comic strips website went offline in October of 2017.

Pages 583-1299:
Is the old origial version of the comic.
This version has the origial run of the comic with all posted during and after the comic's run before the website went offline in October of 2017. This includes any and all extras filler pages as well as color pages the artist omited when reupdating the comic.

Pages 1300-1328:
Is just extras stuff that relates to the comic and/or the characters in the comic.
